items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Alfred Lyon was very enthused -- he started calling me on quite a few record dates

ctx.x: But anyway, I said, "Okay" and he said, "And you don't have to bring your bass" he said to Don, and Don said "Will it be all if he uses yours?" right for you here?" he and I said, "Yeah, that'd be fine."

So the next afternoon, I show up. Elvin Evelyn is sitting there, and so we're sitting there at the table, and Rudy Van Gelder's I look up there and they got all this equipment set up in Alfred Lion and Don and Pete are waiting on line, and Sonny. No, down in peak with Sonny and Sonny comes in and he doesn't say a word to us, he just walks back and goes on up toward the stage, so I'm thinking, I think, well, he's going up there and he'll want me to play a set, a warmup, and then call us to play whatever go into…
